entities.name: Zagoth
entities.description: One of the five triomes of Ikoria, a wild region of rainforest, swamp and wetland aligned with green mana, home to monstrous beasts.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane known for its wild, monster-dominated ecosystem; Zagoth is one of its five triomes.

entities.name: Brokkos
entities.description: The powerful and ancient apex monster of Zagoth, a beast of titanic proportions both feared and awed.

entities.name: Beast clade
entities.description: The dominant monster clade in Zagoth, mostly herbivores resembling antelopes, elk, boars, horses, rhinos or camels.

relations.note: One of the five triomes making up its continent.
relations.quote: Zagoth is one of the five triomes that make up the continent of Ikoria
The apex monster of Zagoth is the powerful and ancient Brokkos
